- Overall performance: The company's revenue after eliminations is $28.37 billion with a gross margin of 47.7% and an EBITDA margin of 28.8%.

- Margins: The company has a gross margin of 47.7% and an EBITDA margin of 28.8%, with Wipro Infrastructure Engineering having the highest gross margin at 58.7% and Wipro Consumer Care International having the highest EBITDA margin at 43.3%.
- Working capital: The company's working capital as of 2026-07-01 is managed with a DSO of 123 days and a DPO of 300 days, indicating a need for improvement in accounts payable.
- Top 3 revenue drivers: The top drivers are everything excluding business Joint Ventures with a revenue change of $0.62 billion (87.6% of total change), SAP product sales with a revenue change of $0.62 billion (88% of total change), and business Joint Ventures with a revenue change of $0.09 billion (12.4% of total change).
